name: Villaviciosa de Odón (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with a yellow castle surmounted by two crossed yellow axes.
history: The arms of Villaviciosa de Odón were approved on 21 December 1976; the flag, approved on 21 January 2000, is of proportions 2:3, a green cloth with a golden castle embattled, masoned black and open red, surmounted by crossed axes.
